details: Local research/discovery-first-slice-2026-11-11.md contains source links, an unexecuted example, semantic limits, and a proposed two-shard Linux probe and performance study. No implementation is recommended until evidence identifies a missing capability; no build, runtime test, source patch or public comment was made.
summary: Source and documentation research identified explicit-list query-facet coverage as a candidate baseline; Luke index field enumeration is not filtered coverage, and facet output limits and existing time/CPU limits are not a hard aggregate resource budget.
